final: SELECT g.ordervault, g.group_count, g.group_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS quotient FROM (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault) AS g CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault) WHERE group_count IS NOT NULL) AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY quotient IS NULL, quotient DESC LIMIT 10
